name: Provision FCRM test board
description: Create four synthetic bank initiatives, add collaboration notes, and distribute them across the five FCRM workflow statuses through Jira transitions.
assumptions: Board ID and placement settings come from data/config/jira-integration.json.
Board columns are driven by Jira status; no swimlane is assumed or directly changed by this scenario.
The FCRM Jira workflow uses Intake, Context and Research, Risk Assessment, Review, and Decision.
Items remain unassigned because Jira account IDs are site-specific.
